_readme: First-hand visit data, filled in by a person who actually visited. Never put estimates or web-sourced facts here. Keys are cafe slugs (see data/cafes.json). Copy one 'example-template' entry, rename the key to the cafe slug, and fill only the fields you measured; delete the ones you did not. Any cafe with an entry becomes indexable and shows a 'Visit notes' section. See seo/visit-intake-template.md.

example-template.wifiNote: speed test app + time of day + which seat
example-template.seatingNote: table sizes, how many seats you counted
example-template.timeLimit: none | stated limit | unwritten pressure, as observed
